research.name: @playcanvas/react
research.note: React components for the PlayCanvas 3D engine, with built-in physics, pointer events, asset loading and Gaussian splat rendering.

effects: Gaussian splat rendering as a JSX component (<GSplat> with useSplat for PLY/SOG files)
declarative entity-component 3D scenes in JSX on the PlayCanvas engine (Application, Entity, Camera, Render)
pointer-pushed rigid bodies in zero gravity from built-in physics

unverified: No example was seen running: only static README screenshots were viewed (hero skull render, Motion example, Physics example), so motion, spring animation and pointer interaction are taken from the docs text.
No Gaussian splat output was seen; the GSplat component is documented in the API page but no image of its rendering was viewed.
